Information criterion for Tucker3 rank selection

Source: R/calibration.R
tucker3_info_criterion.Rd

Computes BIC or AIC for a Tucker3 decomposition with given ranks. Much faster than cross-validation and useful for initial rank screening.

Usage

tucker3_info_criterion(
  mx_array,
  R_A,
  R_B,
  R_C,
  method = c("coda", "direct"),
  criterion = c("bic", "aic"),
  ages = NULL,
  width = 5
)

Arguments

mx_array

3D array of mortality rates.

R_A, R_B, R_C

Integer Tucker3 ranks.

method

"coda" or "direct".

criterion

"bic" (default) or "aic".

ages

Integer vector of age-group starts (required for "coda").

width

Age-group width (default 5).

Value

A list with criterion (BIC/AIC value), fit_pct, n_params, and ranks.
